statements.impact_statement: A maintenance notice, not a vulnerability: bincode 2.0.1 is reported unmaintained. It is a transitive dependency of the GUI toolkit's font and image stack and handles only data the application generated itself. Reviewed at each release; replaced when the toolkit moves.

A maintenance notice, not a vulnerability: paste 1.0.15 is a procedural macro used at compile time by the image decoder the GUI toolkit pulls in. No paste code runs in the shipped binary. Reviewed at each release.

A maintenance notice, not a vulnerability: rustybuzz 0.20.1 is the text shaper behind the GUI toolkit's SVG renderer. It processes only the application's own fonts and text. Reviewed at each release; replaced when the toolkit moves.

A maintenance notice, not a vulnerability: ttf-parser 0.25.1 parses the application's own bundled fonts for the GUI toolkit. No untrusted font reaches it. Reviewed at each release; replaced when the toolkit moves.
